title: Add spend ledger and audit event invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add Dispatch::verify_dispatch_invariants, LedgerEntry::verify_entry_invariants, LedgerIntegrityReport::verify_report_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/ledger.rs and Event::verify_event_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/event.rs with comprehensive unit tests.
acceptance: Dispatch::verify_dispatch_invariants, LedgerEntry::verify_entry_invariants, LedgerIntegrityReport::verify_report_invariants, and Event::verify_event_invariants validate structural, chronological, and settled-cost invariants and reject adversarial tampering.
